old: Two candidates were considered for why the live page 404s: the path moved, or the page was withdrawn. The archive shows it existed in October 2025 with the same content shape and the same deferral to a post-login limits page, so a move is the more likely and nothing suggests the free tier closed. The rung is documented, not measured: the 401 proves the endpoint and not the allowance. This record is stale by design: its only first-party evidence for the free tier is an archived page 378 days old, because the live documentation path 404s. The alternative was to keep the tier unrecorded, which would have left a claim with no evidence at all. Re-read it when the docs site serves a tier page again.
new: Free mode is the current free API tier: it is the default state of a new account, API access is enabled by default with no credit card, and its rate limits are the lowest, intended for evaluation and prototyping. In its help article as archived on 2026-05-18, the free API tier was the Experiment plan, which required a verified phone number, one phone number per plan, and no credit card; that article is no longer served. The former docs paths deployment/laplateforme/tier and deployment/ai-studio/tier answer page not found; the limits are described under admin/workspaces/usage-limits, admin/billing-usage/usage-limits and the help article on API rate limits.
